summary: The proof correctly derives two affine half-plane constraints on every point of the strict P_l cell from convexity and the two full cutting-line chords, transforms them with unit Jacobian into a lens in (r,s)-coordinates, and computes the lens area under the stated intercept-order condition. All denominators and intercepts are positive under the strict endpoint ordering, the equality case in the intercept condition remains covered, and the numerical specialization is exact and yields the claimed contradiction with c=3/10.
